svg.title: Northern Development Initiative Trust — Northern Trust logo, 2006 Annual Report
svg.desc: Native vector artwork cut from the front cover (PDF page 1) of the trust's 2006 Annual Report (PDF created 11 April 2007): the northern Trust script wordmark, the NORTHERN DEVELOPMENT INITIATIVE TRUST line, and the square symbol of a river under stars, whose blue gradient is the PDF's own axial shading inside its vector clip. Converted to SVG by Poppler's pdftocairo, which writes the shading as an SVG gradient; only drawing outside the logo is removed. No tracing, retyping or raster.
